lexicon.title: Translations
lexicon.description: When a blueprint wraps a label in double braces, such as the blueprint name or a tab label, each user sees its translation in their language. Labels without a translation show the English text.
lexicon.readOnly: You can view translations. Changing them requires permission to edit blueprints.
lexicon.noTranslations: No translations in {{language}} yet. Labels in this language show their English text until you add some.
lexicon.needsTranslationDescription: Blueprints or reusable attributes use these labels, but they have no {{language}} translation and show the English text.
lexicon.fullyTranslated: Every translatable label has a translation in {{language}}.
lexicon.missingPluralCategories: Missing plural forms: {{categories}}. These appear next to counts, such as Explorer result totals.
lexicon.keyHelp: The English text inside the braces, matched exactly.
lexicon.contextHelp: Optional. The text after | that separates labels with the same English text. Users never see it.
lexicon.pluralCategoryHelp: Choose “{{category}}” for labels shown without a number.
lexicon.unusedDescription: No blueprint revision or reusable attribute references this key.
lexicon.deleteTranslationDescription: Delete the “{{category}}” translation of “{{key}}”? Labels using it will show the English text.
lexicon.importDescription: Choose a JSON or TOML file created by Export or acli lexicon export. The file sets the language.
lexicon.invalidFile: This is not a valid translation file.
lexicon.invalidLanguage: The file's language is not a valid language tag.

importModes.merge: Add new entries and update existing ones; keep the rest
importModes.replace: Replace the file's language; delete entries missing from the file
